11/04/2023
Claim reported by the insured's policyholder after a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection. The claimant has
retained counsel, and all further contact is to go through the attorney's office.
12/02/2023
Confirmed the driver is named on the policy and that coverage was active at the time of loss. Nothing in the file
suggests the vehicle damage perdates the policy start.
01/02/2024
Photos from the scene and the repair shop show damage consistent with the described impact. No independent
witnesses have come forward, so photos are the main visual record for now.
02/03/2024
Police report places the claimant in the vehicle at the time of collision, and the responding officer's notes match the
account given to us. Vehicle damage aligns with the reported point and force of impact.
02/05/2024
Counsel submitted the initial injury summary, reporting neck strain. The reported injury fits the kind and force of a
rear-end impact of this type.
02/19/2024
Claimant's account was given in a recorded call and again in the follow-up interview, and the core details were the
same both times. Requested the medical records and itemized bills from the treating provider.
05/19/2024
Medical records show no prior treatment to the neck or upper back, and our index search returned no earlier claims
for the same body area.
05/26/2024
Treatment has run somewhat longer than is typical for a neck strain of this severity. Requested the treating
physician's notes explaining the expected recovery timeline and the reasons for continued visits.
06/14/2024
Reviewed the vehicle's prior repair history and found no earlier damage on record. The repair estimate is being
checked against the photos and the reported impact.
06/27/2024
Sent a status letter to counsel lsiting outstanding items: the physician's treatment notes, the final itemized bills, and
the repair invoice. Will reassess once these are received.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
